/// <summary>How <c>RocketsClient</c> authenticates, as <c>Clients:RocketsClient:Authentication</c> or a connection string says.</summary>
[global::System.CodeDom.Compiler.GeneratedCode("Chirograph", "{chirograph-version}")]
public enum RocketsClientAuthentication
{
    /// <summary>Configuration sets no credentials: the client authenticates as the container says, if at all.</summary>
    None,

    /// <summary>An API key, in a header (<c>X-Api-Key</c> unless <c>ApiKeyHeader</c> names another) or in the query (<c>ApiKeyQuery</c>).</summary>
    ApiKey,

    /// <summary>A bearer token, <c>Authorization: Bearer</c>, from <c>Token</c> or from <c>TokenProvider</c> in code.</summary>
    Bearer,

    /// <summary>A user name and password, <c>Authorization: Basic</c>.</summary>
    Basic,

    /// <summary>
    ///     Azure.Identity's <c>DefaultAzureCredential</c>, which tries the environment, workload identity, managed identity and the
    ///     developer tools in turn: a token for <c>Scope</c>, with <c>TenantId</c> and <c>ClientId</c> (of a user-assigned managed identity
    ///     or a workload identity) if set. Needs <c>Azure</c> in the client's <c>Authentication</c> metadata.
    /// </summary>
    AzureDefault,

    /// <summary>
    ///     Azure.Identity's <c>ManagedIdentityCredential</c>: a token for <c>Scope</c> from the managed identity of the host, the
    ///     user-assigned one whose client id is <c>ClientId</c> if set. Needs <c>Azure</c> in the client's <c>Authentication</c> metadata.
    /// </summary>
    AzureManagedIdentity,

    /// <summary>
    ///     Azure.Identity's <c>WorkloadIdentityCredential</c> (Kubernetes workload identity federation): a token for <c>Scope</c>, with
    ///     <c>TenantId</c> and <c>ClientId</c> if set, else the platform's environment variables. Needs <c>Azure</c> in the client's
    ///     <c>Authentication</c> metadata.
    /// </summary>
    AzureWorkloadIdentity,

    /// <summary>
    ///     Azure.Identity's <c>ClientSecretCredential</c>, or <c>ClientCertificateCredential</c> with the client certificate: a token for
    ///     <c>Scope</c> for the application <c>ClientId</c> of the tenant <c>TenantId</c>, with <c>ClientSecret</c> or the
    ///     <c>Certificate*</c> keys. Needs <c>Azure</c> in the client's <c>Authentication</c> metadata.
    /// </summary>
    AzureServicePrincipal,
}

                {
                    options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{where} is a value, and must be an array of hosts (a comma-separated list is for a connection string).");

    private void ApplyConnectionString(global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options)
    {
        if (_configuration is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        var source = ConnectionStringKey;
        var connectionString = _configuration.GetSection(ConnectionStringKey).Value;
        if (connectionString is null)
        {
            source = FallbackConnectionStringKey;
            connectionString = _configuration[FallbackConnectionStringKey];
        }

        if (connectionString is { Length: > 0 })
        {
            ApplyConnectionString(options, connectionString, source);
        }
    }

    // an absolute http or https URI; with service discovery, its scheme may be a +-list of them too, such as https+http
    private static bool IsBaseAddress(string baseAddress)
    {
        if (!global::System.Uri.TryCreate(baseAddress, global::System.UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
        {
            return false;
        }

        return uri.Scheme == global::System.Uri.UriSchemeHttp || uri.Scheme == global::System.Uri.UriSchemeHttps;
    }

    /// <summary>Checks the options, whichever source set them.</summary>
    public global::Microsoft.Extensions.Options.ValidateOptionsResult Validate(string? name, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options)
    {
        if ((name ?? global::Microsoft.Extensions.Options.Options.DefaultName) != global::Microsoft.Extensions.Options.Options.DefaultName)
        {
            return global::Microsoft.Extensions.Options.ValidateOptionsResult.Skip;
        }

        var failures = new global::System.Collections.Generic.List<string>(options.ConfigurationErrors);
        if (options.BaseAddress is { Length: > 0 } baseAddress && !IsBaseAddress(baseAddress))
        {
            failures.Add(
                "The BaseAddress of RocketsClient is not an absolute http or https URI. A service-discovery address, such as https+http://RocketsClient, needs the project to reference Microsoft.Extensions.ServiceDiscovery."
            );
        }

        if (options.Timeout is { } timeout
         && timeout != global::System.Threading.Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan
         && (timeout <= global::System.TimeSpan.Zero || timeout.TotalMilliseconds > int.MaxValue))
        {
            failures.Add("The Timeout of RocketsClient must be positive and at most 24.20:31:23.647, or infinite (-00:00:00.001).");
        }

        foreach (var header in options.DefaultRequestHeaders)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(header.Key))
            {
                failures.Add("The DefaultRequestHeaders of RocketsClient have a header without a name.");
            }
        }

        foreach (var host in options.AllowedHosts)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(host))
            {
                failures.Add("The AllowedHosts of RocketsClient have an empty host.");
            }
        }

        ValidateAuthentication(options, failures);
        global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientCertificate.Validate(options, failures);
        return failures.Count == 0
            ? global::Microsoft.Extensions.Options.ValidateOptionsResult.Success
            : global::Microsoft.Extensions.Options.ValidateOptionsResult.Fail(failures);
    }

    // the keys each method needs, and that no other method's keys are set
    private static void ValidateAuthentication(global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options, global::System.Collections.Generic.List<string> failures)
    {
        var method = options.Authentication;
        // each method's keys, and whether they are set: a key set for a method other than the one chosen is an error
        var keys = new (string Key, bool IsSet, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication Method)[]
        {
            ("ApiKey", options.ApiKey is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.ApiKey),
            ("ApiKeyHeader", options.ApiKeyHeader is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.ApiKey),
            ("ApiKeyQuery", options.ApiKeyQuery is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.ApiKey),
            ("Token", options.Token is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.Bearer),
            ("TokenProvider", options.TokenProvider is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.Bearer),
            ("Username", options.Username is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.Basic),
            ("Password", options.Password is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.Basic),
            ("Scope", options.Scope is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureDefault),
            ("TenantId", options.TenantId is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureDefault),
            ("ClientId", options.ClientId is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureDefault),
            ("Scope", options.Scope is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureManagedIdentity),
            ("ClientId", options.ClientId is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureManagedIdentity),
            ("Scope", options.Scope is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureWorkloadIdentity),
            ("TenantId", options.TenantId is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureWorkloadIdentity),
            ("ClientId", options.ClientId is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureWorkloadIdentity),
            ("Scope", options.Scope is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureServicePrincipal),
            ("TenantId", options.TenantId is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureServicePrincipal),
            ("ClientId", options.ClientId is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureServicePrincipal),
            ("ClientSecret", options.ClientSecret is not null, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureServicePrincipal),
        };
        // a key two methods share is listed once, with both
        var others = new global::System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
        var seen = new global::System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string>(global::System.StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var key in keys)
        {
            if (!key.IsSet || !seen.Add(key.Key))
            {
                continue;
            }

            var owners = new global::System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
            var allowed = false;
            foreach (var owner in keys)
            {
                if (owner.Key == key.Key)
                {
                    owners.Add(owner.Method.ToString());
                    allowed |= owner.Method == method;
                }
            }

            if (!allowed)
            {
                others.Add($"{key.Key} ({string.Join(", ", owners)})");
            }
        }

        if (others.Count > 0)
        {
            failures.Add($"The Authentication of RocketsClient is {method}, and keys of another method are set: {string.Join(", ", others)}.");
        }

        switch (method)
        {
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.None:
                return;
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.ApiKey:
                if (options.ApiKey is null)
                {
                    failures.Add("The Authentication of RocketsClient is ApiKey, which needs ApiKey (or Key).");
                }

                if (options.ApiKeyHeader is not null && options.ApiKeyQuery is not null)
                {
                    failures.Add("The Authentication of RocketsClient is ApiKey, which takes ApiKeyHeader or ApiKeyQuery, not both.");
                }

                break;
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.Bearer:
                if (options.Token is null && options.TokenProvider is null)
                {
                    failures.Add("The Authentication of RocketsClient is Bearer, which needs Token, or TokenProvider in code.");
                }

                if (options.Token is not null && options.TokenProvider is not null)
                {
                    failures.Add("The Authentication of RocketsClient is Bearer, which takes Token or TokenProvider, not both.");
                }

                break;
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.Basic:
                if (options.Username is null || options.Password is null)
                {
                    failures.Add("The Authentication of RocketsClient is Basic, which needs Username and Password.");
                }

                if (options.Username?.IndexOf(':') >= 0)
                {
                    failures.Add("The Username of RocketsClient has a colon, which Basic authentication cannot send.");
                }

                break;
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureDefault:
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureManagedIdentity:
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureWorkloadIdentity:
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureServicePrincipal:
                global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAzureCredential.Validate(options, failures);
                break;
            default:
                failures.Add($"The Authentication of RocketsClient is not a method it can use: {AuthenticationList}.");
                return;
        }

        if (options.BaseAddress is not { Length: > 0 } && options.AllowedHosts.Count == 0)
        {
            failures.Add($"The Authentication of RocketsClient is {method}, and it has no host to send the credentials to: set BaseAddress, or AllowedHosts.");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    ///     Parses a connection string with the syntax of <c>DbConnectionStringBuilder</c> (<c>key=value</c> pairs separated by <c>;</c>, a
    ///     value quoted with <c>'</c> or <c>"</c> when it holds a <c>;</c> or leading or trailing spaces, a doubled quote standing for
    ///     itself), and applies it. An unknown key, a key given twice (an alias with its key too) and a malformed string are errors.
    /// </summary>
    private static void ApplyConnectionString(global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options, string connectionString, string source)
    {
        var seen = new global::System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, string>(global::System.StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        var unknown = false;
        var i = 0;
        while (true)
        {
            while (i < connectionString.Length && (connectionString[i] == ';' || char.IsWhiteSpace(connectionString[i])))
            {
                i++;
            }

            if (i == connectionString.Length)
            {
                break;
            }

            var keyStart = i;
            while (i < connectionString.Length && connectionString[i] != '=' && connectionString[i] != ';')
            {
                i++;
            }

            if (i == connectionString.Length || connectionString[i] != '=')
            {
                // the text may be a secret written without its key: it isn't repeated
                options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{source} has a part that isn't key=value.");
                return;
            }

            var key = connectionString.Substring(keyStart, i - keyStart).Trim();
            i++;
            // key== is the rest of a value with a ; in it (base64 padding, say), not a key
            var keyLike = LooksLikeKey(key) && (i == connectionString.Length || connectionString[i] != '=');
            while (i < connectionString.Length && connectionString[i] != ';' && char.IsWhiteSpace(connectionString[i]))
            {
                i++;
            }

            string value;
            if (i < connectionString.Length && (connectionString[i] == SingleQuote || connectionString[i] == '"'))
            {
                var quote = connectionString[i++];
                var builder = new global::System.Text.StringBuilder();
                var closed = false;
                while (i < connectionString.Length)
                {
                    if (connectionString[i] == quote)
                    {
                        if (i + 1 < connectionString.Length && connectionString[i + 1] == quote)
                        {
                            builder.Append(quote);
                            i += 2;
                            continue;
                        }

                        i++;
                        closed = true;
                        break;
                    }

                    builder.Append(connectionString[i++]);
                }

                if (!closed)
                {
                    options.ConfigurationErrors.Add(
                        Keys.ContainsKey(key)
                            ? $"{source} has a quoted value without its closing quote, for {key}."
                            : $"{source} has a quoted value without its closing quote."
                    );
                    return;
                }

                while (i < connectionString.Length && char.IsWhiteSpace(connectionString[i]))
                {
                    i++;
                }

                if (i < connectionString.Length && connectionString[i] != ';')
                {
                    options.ConfigurationErrors.Add(
                        Keys.ContainsKey(key)
                            ? $"{source} has more after the closing quote of the value of {key}."
                            : $"{source} has more after the closing quote of a value."
                    );
                    return;
                }

                value = builder.ToString();
            }
            else
            {
                var valueStart = i;
                while (i < connectionString.Length && connectionString[i] != ';')
                {
                    i++;
                }

                value = connectionString.Substring(valueStart, i - valueStart).Trim();
            }

            if (key.Length == 0)
            {
                options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{source} has a value without a key.");
                continue;
            }

            if (!Keys.TryGetValue(key, out var name))
            {
                // only text that reads as a key is named: anything else may be the rest of a secret written with a ; and no quotes
                options.ConfigurationErrors.Add(
                    string.Equals(key, "DefaultRequestHeaders", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                        ? $"{source} has DefaultRequestHeaders, which only {SectionKey} can set."
                        : keyLike
                            ? $"{source} has an unknown key, {key}. Its keys are {ConnectionStringKeyList}."
                            : $"{source} has an unrecognised part."
                );
                unknown = true;
                continue;
            }

            if (seen.TryGetValue(name, out var other))
            {
                options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{source} sets {name} twice, as {other} and as {key}.");
                continue;
            }

            seen[name] = key;
            if (value.Length > 0)
            {
                Apply(options, name, value, $"{source} ({key})");
            }
        }

        if (unknown && source == FallbackConnectionStringKey)
        {
            options.ConfigurationErrors.Add(
                $"When {FallbackConnectionStringKey} is the connection string of something else, set {ConnectionStringKey} to an empty value: the client then doesn't read it."
            );
        }
    }

    // whether the text reads as a key: a letter, then letters, digits and spaces, as a key name is written
    private static bool LooksLikeKey(string text)
    {
        if (text.Length is 0 or > 64 || !IsLetter(text[0]))
        {
            return false;
        }

        foreach (var c in text)
        {
            if (!IsLetter(c) && c is not (>= '0' and <= '9') && c != ' ')
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private static bool IsLetter(char c) => c is (>= 'a' and <= 'z') or (>= 'A' and <= 'Z');

    // sets the option a key stands for from its text
    private static void Apply(global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options, string name, string value, string where)
    {
        switch (name)
        {
            case "BaseAddress":
                options.BaseAddress = value;
                break;
            case "Timeout":
                if (global::System.TimeSpan.TryParse(value, global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var timeout))
                {
                    options.Timeout = timeout;
                }
                else
                {
                    options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{where} is not a TimeSpan, such as 00:00:30.");
                }

                break;
            case "Resilience":
                if (bool.TryParse(value, out var resilience))
                {
                    options.Resilience = resilience;
                }
                else
                {
                    options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{where} is not true or false.");
                }

                break;
            case "AllowedHosts":
                options.AllowedHosts.Clear();
                foreach (var host in value.Split(','))
                {
                    if (host.Trim() is { Length: > 0 } trimmed)
                    {
                        options.AllowedHosts.Add(trimmed);
                    }
                }

                break;
            case "Authentication":
                foreach (var method in Methods)
                {
                    if (string.Equals(value, method.Key, global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        options.Authentication = method.Value;
                        return;
                    }
                }

                foreach (var declared in DeclaredMethods)
                {
                    if (string.Equals(value, declared.Key, global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        options.ConfigurationErrors.Add(
                            $"{where} is {declared.Key}, which the OpenApiClient item of RocketsClient doesn't declare: add {declared.Value} to its Authentication metadata."
                        );
                        return;
                    }
                }

                options.ConfigurationErrors.Add($"{where} is not a method RocketsClient can use: {AuthenticationList}.");
                break;
            // an empty value leaves a key unset
            case "ApiKey":
                options.ApiKey = value.Length > 0 ? value : null;
                break;
            case "ApiKeyHeader":
                options.ApiKeyHeader = value.Length > 0 ? value : null;
                break;
            case "ApiKeyQuery":
                options.ApiKeyQuery = value.Length > 0 ? value : null;
                break;
            case "Token":
                options.Token = value.Length > 0 ? value : null;
                break;
            case "Username":
                options.Username = value.Length > 0 ? value : null;
                break;
            case "Password":
                options.Password = value.Length > 0 ? value : null;
                break;
            case "CertificatePath":
                options.CertificatePath = value.Length > 0 ? value : null;
                break;
            case "CertificatePassword":
                options.CertificatePassword = value.Length > 0 ? value : null;
                break;
            case "CertificateKeyPath":
                options.CertificateKeyPath = value.Length > 0 ? value : null;
                break;
            case "CertificateThumbprint":
                options.CertificateThumbprint = value.Length > 0 ? value : null;
                break;
            case "CertificateStore":
                options.CertificateStore = value.Length > 0 ? value : null;
                break;
            case "ClientId":
                options.ClientId = value.Length > 0 ? value : null;
                break;
            case "ClientSecret":
                options.ClientSecret = value.Length > 0 ? value : null;
                break;
            case "Scope":
                options.Scope = value.Length > 0 ? value : null;
                break;
            case "TenantId":
                options.TenantId = value.Length > 0 ? value : null;
                break;
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
///     Adds the credentials <see cref="RocketsClientOptions" /> configures to the requests of <c>RocketsClient</c>, when its Authentication
///     isn't <c>None</c>, and only to the <c>BaseAddress</c> host (and port) and the <c>AllowedHosts</c>. It follows redirects in place of the
///     primary handler, so every hop passes the same check: a redirect to another host goes without the credentials.
/// </summary>
[global::System.CodeDom.Compiler.GeneratedCode("Chirograph", "{chirograph-version}")]
internal sealed class RocketsClientAuthenticationHandler : global::System.Net.Http.DelegatingHandler
{
    private const string DefaultApiKeyHeader = "X-Api-Key";

    private readonly global::System.IServiceProvider _services;
    private readonly global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions _options;
    private readonly global::System.Uri? _baseAddress;
    private readonly int _maxRedirects;

    private RocketsClientAuthenticationHandler(global::System.IServiceProvider services, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options, int maxRedirects)
    {
        _services = services;
        _options = options;
        _maxRedirects = maxRedirects;
        _baseAddress = global::System.Uri.TryCreate(options.BaseAddress, global::System.UriKind.Absolute, out var baseAddress) ? baseAddress : null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    ///     Adds the handler after the handlers added so far, when the options in effect as the handlers are built set an Authentication, and
    ///     takes over the redirects of the primary handler.
    /// </summary>
    internal static void Configure(global::Microsoft.Extensions.Http.HttpMessageHandlerBuilder builder)
    {
        var options = global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ServiceProviderServiceExtensions
                     .GetRequiredService<global::Microsoft.Extensions.Options.IOptionsMonitor<global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions>>(builder.Services)
                     .CurrentValue;
        if (options.Authentication == global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.None)
        {
            return;
        }

        builder.AdditionalHandlers.Add(new global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthenticationHandler(builder.Services, options, TakeOverRedirects(builder.PrimaryHandler)));
    }

    // the primary handler would follow a redirect with every header of the request: it stops following them, and the handler follows as
    // many as it would have
    private static int TakeOverRedirects(global::System.Net.Http.HttpMessageHandler? handler)
    {
        while (handler is global::System.Net.Http.DelegatingHandler { InnerHandler: { } inner })
        {
            handler = inner;
        }

        switch (handler)
        {
            case global::System.Net.Http.SocketsHttpHandler { AllowAutoRedirect: true } sockets:
                sockets.AllowAutoRedirect = false;
                return sockets.MaxAutomaticRedirections;
            case global::System.Net.Http.HttpClientHandler { AllowAutoRedirect: true } client:
                client.AllowAutoRedirect = false;
                return client.MaxAutomaticRedirections;
            default:
                return 0;
        }
    }

    /// <inheritdoc />
    protected override async global::System.Threading.Tasks.Task<global::System.Net.Http.HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(
        global::System.Net.Http.HttpRequestMessage request,
        global::System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken
    )
    {
        for (var redirects = 0; ; redirects++)
        {
            if (IsAllowed(request.RequestUri))
            {
                await AuthenticateAsync(request, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }

            var response = await base.SendAsync(request, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            if (redirects >= _maxRedirects || Redirect(request, response) is not { } next)
            {
                return response;
            }

            response.Dispose();
            request = next;
        }
    }

    // the BaseAddress host, on its port, and the AllowedHosts: a host alone allows each of its ports, host:port that port
    private bool IsAllowed(global::System.Uri? uri)
    {
        if (uri is not { IsAbsoluteUri: true })
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (_baseAddress is not null
         && string.Equals(uri.Host, _baseAddress.Host, global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
         && uri.Port == _baseAddress.Port)
        {
            return true;
        }

        foreach (var host in _options.AllowedHosts)
        {
            if (string.Equals(host, uri.Host, global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
             || string.Equals(host, uri.Host + ":" + uri.Port, global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    // sets the credentials of the method on the request, replacing any it has (a request sent again, say)
    private async global::System.Threading.Tasks.ValueTask AuthenticateAsync(global::System.Net.Http.HttpRequestMessage request, global::System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        switch (_options.Authentication)
        {
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.ApiKey when _options.ApiKeyQuery is { } query:
                request.RequestUri = WithQueryParameter(request.RequestUri!, query, _options.ApiKey!);
                break;
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.ApiKey:
                var header = _options.ApiKeyHeader ?? DefaultApiKeyHeader;
                request.Headers.Remove(header);
                request.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation(header, _options.ApiKey);
                break;
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.Bearer:
                var token = _options.Token ?? await _options.TokenProvider!(_services, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
                request.Headers.Authorization = new global::System.Net.Http.Headers.AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
                break;
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.Basic:
                request.Headers.Authorization = new global::System.Net.Http.Headers.AuthenticationHeaderValue(
                    "Basic",
                    global::System.Convert.ToBase64String(global::System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_options.Username + ":" + _options.Password))
                );
                break;
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureDefault:
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureManagedIdentity:
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureWorkloadIdentity:
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureServicePrincipal:
                request.Headers.Authorization = new global::System.Net.Http.Headers.AuthenticationHeaderValue(
                    "Bearer",
                    await global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAzureCredential.GetAccessTokenAsync(_services, _options, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false)
                );
                break;
        }
    }

    // the URI with the query parameter set to the value, once
    private static global::System.Uri WithQueryParameter(global::System.Uri uri, string name, string value)
    {
        var escapedName = global::System.Uri.EscapeDataString(name);
        var builder = new global::System.UriBuilder(uri);
        var parameters = new global::System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
        foreach (var parameter in builder.Query.TrimStart('?').Split('&'))
        {
            if (parameter.Length > 0 && parameter != escapedName && !parameter.StartsWith(escapedName + "=", global::System.StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                parameters.Add(parameter);
            }
        }

        parameters.Add(escapedName + "=" + global::System.Uri.EscapeDataString(value));
        builder.Query = string.Join("&", parameters);
        return builder.Uri;
    }

    // the request a redirect asks for, as the primary handler would have made it, without the credentials of this one; null when the
    // response isn't a redirect it would follow
    private global::System.Net.Http.HttpRequestMessage? Redirect(global::System.Net.Http.HttpRequestMessage request, global::System.Net.Http.HttpResponseMessage response)
    {
        var status = (int)response.StatusCode;
        if (status is not (301 or 302 or 303 or 307 or 308) || response.Headers.Location is not { } location || request.RequestUri is not { } from)
        {
            return null;
        }

        // a relative location resolves against the request's URI, which under service discovery is the logical one (https+http://name/),
        // so the redirected request is resolved again, and keeps the credentials of the logical host
        var to = location.IsAbsoluteUri ? location : new global::System.Uri(from, location);
        // http, https or the request's own (logical) scheme, and no downgrade from https to http
        if ((to.Scheme != global::System.Uri.UriSchemeHttp && to.Scheme != global::System.Uri.UriSchemeHttps && to.Scheme != from.Scheme)
         || (from.Scheme == global::System.Uri.UriSchemeHttps && to.Scheme == global::System.Uri.UriSchemeHttp))
        {
            return null;
        }

        var method = request.Method;
        var content = request.Content;
        if ((status is 301 or 302 && method == global::System.Net.Http.HttpMethod.Post) || (status == 303 && method != global::System.Net.Http.HttpMethod.Head))
        {
            method = global::System.Net.Http.HttpMethod.Get;
            content = null;
        }

        var next = new global::System.Net.Http.HttpRequestMessage(method, to) { Content = content, Version = request.Version, VersionPolicy = request.VersionPolicy };
        // not the Host header either: it names the host of the first request (service discovery sets it to the endpoint it resolved)
        foreach (var header in request.Headers)
        {
            if (!string.Equals(header.Key, "Authorization", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
             && !string.Equals(header.Key, "Host", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
             && !(_options.Authentication == global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.ApiKey
               && string.Equals(header.Key, _options.ApiKeyHeader ?? DefaultApiKeyHeader, global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            {
                next.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation(header.Key, header.Value);
            }
        }

        foreach (var option in request.Options)
        {
            ((global::System.Collections.Generic.IDictionary<string, object?>)next.Options)[option.Key] = option.Value;
        }

        return next;
    }
}

/// <summary>
///     The certificate of <c>RocketsClient</c>, as the keys <c>CertificatePath</c>, <c>CertificatePassword</c>, <c>CertificateKeyPath</c>,
///     <c>CertificateThumbprint</c> and <c>CertificateStore</c> give it: loading it, checking those keys, and presenting it for mutual TLS.
///     A certificate has one role: a method that signs with it (<see cref="IsForSigning" />) loads it with <see cref="Load" />, and it is
///     then not also presented for mutual TLS. No message repeats a value from configuration.
/// </summary>
[global::System.CodeDom.Compiler.GeneratedCode("Chirograph", "{chirograph-version}")]
internal static class RocketsClientCertificate
{
    private const string DefaultStore = "CurrentUser/My";

    /// <summary>Whether the options give a certificate, by its path or by its thumbprint.</summary>
    internal static bool IsSet(global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options) =>
        options.CertificatePath is { Length: > 0 } || options.CertificateThumbprint is { Length: > 0 };

    /// <summary>
    ///     Whether the client's <see cref="RocketsClientOptions.Authentication" /> signs with the certificate, which is then not also
    ///     presented for mutual TLS.
    /// </summary>
    internal static bool IsForSigning(global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options)
    {
        switch (options.Authentication)
        {
            // a method that signs with the certificate returns true here
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureServicePrincipal:
                return true;
            default:
                return false;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    ///     Sets the certificate on the client's primary handler, for mutual TLS, when the options give one that isn't for signing. It is
    ///     loaded again each time the handler is made, so a renewed file is read when the handlers rotate.
    /// </summary>
    /// <exception cref="global::System.InvalidOperationException">The certificate can't be loaded, or the handler can't present it.</exception>
    internal static void Present(global::System.Net.Http.HttpMessageHandler handler, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options)
    {
        if (!IsSet(options) || IsForSigning(options))
        {
            return;
        }

        var certificate = Load(options);
        switch (handler)
        {
            case global::System.Net.Http.SocketsHttpHandler sockets:
                sockets.SslOptions.ClientCertificates = new global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509CertificateCollection { certificate };
                // offered whichever issuers the server asks for
                sockets.SslOptions.LocalCertificateSelectionCallback = (_, _, _, _, _) => certificate;
                break;
            case global::System.Net.Http.HttpClientHandler client:
                client.ClientCertificateOptions = global::System.Net.Http.ClientCertificateOption.Manual;
                client.ClientCertificates.Add(certificate);
                break;
            default:
                certificate.Dispose();
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException(
                    $"The primary handler of RocketsClient is a {handler.GetType().FullName}, which can't present its client certificate: it must be a SocketsHttpHandler or an HttpClientHandler."
                );
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Loads the certificate the options give, with its private key.</summary>
    /// <exception cref="global::System.InvalidOperationException">The certificate can't be loaded: the message says why, as validation does.</exception>
    internal static global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2 Load(global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options) =>
        TryLoad(options, out var certificate) is { } failure ? throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException(failure) : certificate!;

    /// <summary>
    ///     Checks the certificate keys: a path or a thumbprint, not both; a password or a key path only with a path; a store only with a
    ///     thumbprint; and a certificate, with its private key, that loads.
    /// </summary>
    internal static void Validate(global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options, global::System.Collections.Generic.List<string> failures)
    {
        var path = options.CertificatePath is { Length: > 0 };
        var thumbprint = options.CertificateThumbprint is { Length: > 0 };
        var count = failures.Count;
        if (path && thumbprint)
        {
            failures.Add("RocketsClient has both a CertificatePath and a CertificateThumbprint: its certificate is a file or in a store, not both.");
        }

        if (!path && options.CertificatePassword is { Length: > 0 })
        {
            failures.Add("RocketsClient has a CertificatePassword without a CertificatePath.");
        }

        if (!path && options.CertificateKeyPath is { Length: > 0 })
        {
            failures.Add("RocketsClient has a CertificateKeyPath without a CertificatePath.");
        }

        if (!thumbprint && options.CertificateStore is { Length: > 0 })
        {
            failures.Add("RocketsClient has a CertificateStore without a CertificateThumbprint.");
        }

        if (failures.Count == count && IsSet(options))
        {
            var failure = TryLoad(options, out var certificate);
            certificate?.Dispose();
            if (failure is not null)
            {
                failures.Add(failure);
            }
        }
    }

    // the reason the certificate can't be loaded, or null and the certificate
    private static string? TryLoad(
        global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options,
        out global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2? certificate
    ) =>
        options.CertificateThumbprint is { Length: > 0 } thumbprint
            ? FromStore(thumbprint, options.CertificateStore is { Length: > 0 } store ? store : DefaultStore, out certificate)
            : FromFile(options.CertificatePath ?? "", options.CertificatePassword, options.CertificateKeyPath, out certificate);

    private static string? FromFile(
        string path,
        string? password,
        string? keyPath,
        out global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2? certificate
    )
    {
        certificate = null;
        if (!global::System.IO.File.Exists(path))
        {
            return "The CertificatePath of RocketsClient is not a file that exists.";
        }

        if (keyPath is { Length: > 0 } && !global::System.IO.File.Exists(keyPath))
        {
            return "The CertificateKeyPath of RocketsClient is not a file that exists.";
        }

        var pem = false;
        try
        {
            pem = keyPath is { Length: > 0 } || IsPem(path);
            if (pem)
            {
                using var fromPem = password is { Length: > 0 }
                    ? global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2.CreateFromEncryptedPemFile(path, password, keyPath is { Length: > 0 } ? keyPath : null)
                    : global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2.CreateFromPemFile(path, keyPath is { Length: > 0 } ? keyPath : null);
                // a key read from PEM is ephemeral, which not every platform's TLS stack takes: through PKCS#12, it is one they do
                certificate = LoadPkcs12(fromPem.Export(global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509ContentType.Pkcs12), null);
            }
            else
            {
                certificate = LoadPkcs12(global::System.IO.File.ReadAllBytes(path), password);
            }
        }
        catch (global::System.Exception e) when (e is global::System.Security.Cryptography.CryptographicException or global::System.ArgumentException)
        {
            return pem
                ? "The CertificatePath of RocketsClient is not a PEM certificate with its private key (in the same file, or in CertificateKeyPath), or its CertificatePassword is wrong."
                : "The CertificatePath of RocketsClient is not a PKCS#12 (.pfx or .p12) or PEM certificate, or its CertificatePassword is wrong.";
        }
        catch (global::System.Exception e) when (e is global::System.IO.IOException or global::System.UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            return "The CertificatePath or CertificateKeyPath of RocketsClient can't be read.";
        }

        return HasPrivateKey(ref certificate) ? null : "The certificate of RocketsClient at its CertificatePath has no private key.";
    }

    private static string? FromStore(
        string thumbprint,
        string store,
        out global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2? certificate
    )
    {
        certificate = null;
        var parts = store.Split('/');
        if (parts.Length != 2
         || parts[1].Length == 0
         || !global::System.Enum.TryParse<global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.StoreLocation>(parts[0], true, out var location)
         || !global::System.Enum.IsDefined(typeof(global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.StoreLocation), location))
        {
            return "The CertificateStore of RocketsClient is not <location>/<name>, such as CurrentUser/My or LocalMachine/My.";
        }

        try
        {
            using var x509Store = new global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Store(parts[1], location);
            x509Store.Open(
                global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.OpenFlags.ReadOnly
              | global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.OpenFlags.OpenExistingOnly
            );
            var found = x509Store.Certificates.Find(global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509FindType.FindByThumbprint, thumbprint, false);
            if (found.Count == 0)
            {
                return "The CertificateStore of RocketsClient has no certificate with its CertificateThumbprint.";
            }

            certificate = found[0];
        }
        catch (global::System.Security.Cryptography.CryptographicException)
        {
            return "The CertificateStore of RocketsClient can't be opened.";
        }

        return HasPrivateKey(ref certificate) ? null : "The certificate of RocketsClient in its CertificateStore has no private key.";
    }

    // whether the certificate has its private key; when it hasn't, it is disposed
    private static bool HasPrivateKey(ref global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2? certificate)
    {
        if (certificate is { HasPrivateKey: true })
        {
            return true;
        }

        certificate?.Dispose();
        certificate = null;
        return false;
    }

    // whether the file is PEM text (a certificate, and maybe its key) rather than PKCS#12
    private static bool IsPem(string path)
    {
        using var reader = new global::System.IO.StreamReader(path);
        var start = new char[4096];
        var read = reader.ReadBlock(start, 0, start.Length);
        return new string(start, 0, read).Contains("-----BEGIN ");
    }

    private static global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2 LoadPkcs12(byte[] data, string? password) =>
#if NET9_0_OR_GREATER
        global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509CertificateLoader.LoadPkcs12(data, password);
#else
        new global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2(data, password);
#endif
}

/// <summary>
///     The Azure authentication of <c>RocketsClient</c>, through Azure.Identity: one credential for the client, made from
///     <see cref="RocketsClientOptions" /> the first time a token is asked for and again when the options are reloaded, whose token the
///     authentication handler sets for each request (so the host check applies to it). The credential caches the token and asks for a
///     new one before it expires. A <c>TokenCredential</c> registered keyed with <c>"RocketsClient"</c> is used instead of the one the
///     method makes.
/// </summary>
[global::System.CodeDom.Compiler.GeneratedCode("Chirograph", "{chirograph-version}")]
internal sealed class RocketsClientAzureCredential
{
    /// <summary>The key of a <c>TokenCredential</c> in the container that replaces the one the method makes.</summary>
    internal const string ServiceKey = "RocketsClient";

    private readonly global::System.IServiceProvider _services;
    private readonly object _gate = new object();
    private global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions? _options;
    private global::Azure.Core.TokenCredential? _credential;
    // the certificate of the credential, disposed when the credential is made again
    private global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2? _certificate;

    public RocketsClientAzureCredential(global::System.IServiceProvider services) => _services = services;

    /// <summary>Registers the client's credential, once.</summary>
    internal static void Register(global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection services)
    {
        foreach (var descriptor in services)
        {
            if (descriptor.ServiceType == typeof(global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAzureCredential))
            {
                return;
            }
        }

        services.Add(
            global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ServiceDescriptor.Singleton<global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAzureCredential, global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAzureCredential>()
        );
    }

    /// <summary>
    ///     Checks the keys of the Azure methods: Scope for each, a TenantId that is a tenant id or a domain, and, for
    ///     <c>AzureServicePrincipal</c>, TenantId, ClientId, and ClientSecret or a certificate, one of them. Startup asks Azure for nothing.
    /// </summary>
    internal static void Validate(global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options, global::System.Collections.Generic.List<string> failures)
    {
        if (options.Scope is not { Length: > 0 } scope || scope.Trim().Length == 0)
        {
            failures.Add($"The Authentication of RocketsClient is {options.Authentication}, which needs Scope.");
        }

        if (options.TenantId is { Length: > 0 } tenantId && !IsTenantId(tenantId))
        {
            failures.Add("The TenantId of RocketsClient is not a tenant id or a domain.");
        }

        if (options.Authentication != global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureServicePrincipal)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (options.TenantId is not { Length: > 0 } || options.ClientId is not { Length: > 0 })
        {
            failures.Add("The Authentication of RocketsClient is AzureServicePrincipal, which needs TenantId and ClientId.");
        }

        if ((options.ClientSecret is { Length: > 0 }) == global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientCertificate.IsSet(options))
        {
            failures.Add(
                "The Authentication of RocketsClient is AzureServicePrincipal, which takes ClientSecret or a certificate (CertificatePath or CertificateThumbprint), one of them."
            );
        }
    }

    // what Azure.Identity takes as a tenant: letters, digits, dots and dashes
    private static bool IsTenantId(string tenantId)
    {
        foreach (var c in tenantId)
        {
            if (!(c is (>= 'a' and <= 'z') or (>= 'A' and <= 'Z') or (>= '0' and <= '9') or '.' or '-'))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>The access token for a request: the credential's cached token for Scope, or a new one.</summary>
    /// <exception cref="global::Azure.Identity.AuthenticationFailedException">The credential could not get a token.</exception>
    internal static async global::System.Threading.Tasks.Task<string> GetAccessTokenAsync(
        global::System.IServiceProvider services,
        global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options,
        global::System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken
    )
    {
        var credential = global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ServiceProviderServiceExtensions
                        .GetRequiredService<global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAzureCredential>(services)
                        .Credential(options);
        var scopes = (options.Scope ?? "").Split(new[] { ' ' }, global::System.StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        var token = await credential.GetTokenAsync(new global::Azure.Core.TokenRequestContext(scopes), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        return token.Token;
    }

    // the credential registered for the client, else the one the options make, made again only when they are reloaded
    private global::Azure.Core.TokenCredential Credential(global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options)
    {
        if (_services is global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IKeyedServiceProvider keyed
         && keyed.GetKeyedService(typeof(global::Azure.Core.TokenCredential), ServiceKey) is global::Azure.Core.TokenCredential registered)
        {
            return registered;
        }

        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_credential is null || !ReferenceEquals(_options, options))
            {
                var previous = _certificate;
                _certificate = null;
                _credential = Create(options, out _certificate);
                _options = options;
                previous?.Dispose();
            }

            return _credential;
        }
    }

    private static global::Azure.Core.TokenCredential Create(
        global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientOptions options,
        out global::System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2? certificate
    )
    {
        certificate = null;
        var tenantId = options.TenantId is { Length: > 0 } tenant ? tenant : null;
        var clientId = options.ClientId is { Length: > 0 } client ? client : null;
        switch (options.Authentication)
        {
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureManagedIdentity:
                return new global::Azure.Identity.ManagedIdentityCredential(
                    clientId is null ? global::Azure.Identity.ManagedIdentityId.SystemAssigned : global::Azure.Identity.ManagedIdentityId.FromUserAssignedClientId(clientId)
                );
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureWorkloadIdentity:
                var workload = new global::Azure.Identity.WorkloadIdentityCredentialOptions();
                if (tenantId is not null)
                {
                    workload.TenantId = tenantId;
                }

                if (clientId is not null)
                {
                    workload.ClientId = clientId;
                }

                return new global::Azure.Identity.WorkloadIdentityCredential(workload);
            case global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientAuthentication.AzureServicePrincipal:
                if (options.ClientSecret is { Length: > 0 } secret)
                {
                    return new global::Azure.Identity.ClientSecretCredential(tenantId!, clientId!, secret);
                }

                // the certificate signs the credential's assertions, and isn't presented for mutual TLS
                certificate = global::Throwaway.Clients.RocketsClientCertificate.Load(options);
                return new global::Azure.Identity.ClientCertificateCredential(tenantId!, clientId!, certificate);
            default:
                var defaults = new global::Azure.Identity.DefaultAzureCredentialOptions();
                if (tenantId is not null)
                {
                    defaults.TenantId = tenantId;
                }

                if (clientId is not null)
                {
                    defaults.ManagedIdentityClientId = clientId;
                    defaults.WorkloadIdentityClientId = clientId;
                }

                return new global::Azure.Identity.DefaultAzureCredential(defaults);
        }
    }
}
